constraints: analysis_server_client wraps the analysis_server protocol, so replacing it changes the call sites and not only the dependency entry: migrate the pubspec declaration and the Dart code that imports the package together.
The publisher lists no replacement package on pub.dev, so choose a maintained fork or a direct implementation of the protocol before removing the dependency.

steps.title: Audit the client call sites
steps.instructions: List every file that imports package:analysis_server_client and the client, server, and protocol calls it makes.

steps.title: Choose a maintained replacement
steps.instructions: Pick a maintained fork or implement the analysis_server protocol directly, and confirm the choice supports the Dart SDK constraint in environment.sdk.

steps.title: Replace the dependency
steps.instructions: Update the imports and call sites, replace analysis_server_client in pubspec.yaml, and re-resolve dependencies so pubspec.lock no longer contains it.

verification.purpose: Re-resolve dependencies after replacing the package.
Analyze and test a Dart package on the replacement client.
Analyze and test a Flutter app on the replacement client.
